title: grc-pseudonymizer
summary: grc-pseudonymizer is a batch pseudonymization framework for relational databases (Master's-thesis proof-of-concept) that combines format-preserving encryption, deterministic Faker-based identifier substitution, and Gaussian-copula synthesis of quasi-identifiers, with a web UI, REST API and GDPR/ISO-27001 audit trail. Its production M2 module fits copulas.GaussianMultivariate directly on quasi-identifiers, while its test suite (test_xgboost_v2.py, test_m2_copulas.py) separately imports and runs SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata as a comparison baseline for downstream ML utility.
evidence: test_xgboost_v2.py:71-77: model_sdv = GaussianCopulaSynthesizer(meta); model_sdv.fit(df_qid); df_sint = model_sdv.sample(num_rows=len(df_qid))
needs: pipeline.py imports sdv.single_table.GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and SingleTableMetadata but no call site was shown for that file; only the test scripts show an actual fit/sample call, so it's unclear whether SDV runs in the shipped pipeline or only in tests.
